title: Boston Basic
description: Purchased at Logan Airport in Boston because I didn't have any Boston souvenirs from the trip.

title: Chicken Fajitas
description: Custom design by Tracy Sayre, based on an office in-joke. One of a pair.

title: Star Wars Crystal Fox
description: The crystal fox, a science fiction animal introduced in Star Wars: The Last Jedi.

title: DRI Crossover Tour 2014
description: Purchased at DRI concert at Fitzgerald's in Houston, during their 2014 tour. Album art from Crossover on the front.

title: Chamonix Mont Blanc
description: Triangular Irregular Network (TIN) map of Mont Blanc in France. Purchased in Chamonix.

title: Natas Kaupas
description: 1980s skateboard graphic from the original Natas Kaupas deck from Santa Monica Airlines.

title: Super Mario World
description: Mario and Yoshi from the 1991 Super Nintendo game Super Mario World.

title: Area Code 307
description: 307 is the telephone area code for the entire state of Wyoming. Purchased at Devil's Tower National Monument.

title: Star Wars Adopt a Porg
description: Porgs are cute semi-intelligent animals introduced in Star Wars: The Last Jedi.

title: Alesund
description: This shirt from the city of Alesund has a Norwegian flag patch on it.

title: Aquaholic
description: This shirt was already quite faded when I bought it brand new at Buc-ee's. Features an octopus and the word 'Aquaholic.'

title: Big Bend NP
description: Big Bend National Park, and its iconic animal, the roadrunner.

title: Blushing Japan
description: Japanese tour shirt for the Austin shoegaze band Blushing. Kinda rare in the US.

title: Blushing OG
description: The original shirt design for the Austin shoegaze band Blushing.

title: C2 Back in Blue
description: Schwag for C2, the in-house design agency at Schwab. From an event I didn't attend in 2022.

title: Carlsbad Caverns NP
description: Bought this when I visted Carlsbad Caverns in 2016.

title: Copenhagen
description: A simple design from Copenhagen, featuring the Danish flag.

title: DRI Blue
description: My friend John bought this for me at a DRI show in Denver. Has a logo on the right sleeve.

title: Glacier
description: Simple design from Glacier National Park in Montana.

title: Lofoten
description: Souvenir from the Lofoten National Park store in Ramberg, Norway.

title: The Loyal Seas
description: Logo for The Loyal Seas, a side project from Tanya Donelly.

title: Mammoth Cave NP
description: Bought at Mammoth Cave National Park, when I visited with my sister Terry during the pandemic.

title: May the Forest Be with You
description: This was a popular design at the National Monuments of Arizona many years ago. My dad has the same shirt.

title: Darth Baseball
description: One of my first Star Wars parody shirts. A lot of people see the MLB logo and then do a double take.

title: NASA Death Star
description: I don't actually believe that NASA is part of the evil empire, but this shirt was too fun to pass up.

title: Norway
description: A simple design from Norway, featuring the Norwegian flag.

title: Patiently Waiting for the World to End
description: Humorous shirt I found at a skateboard shop in Oslo, Norway.

title: Redwoods NP
description: I knew it was too small, but I loved the design and wanted to make sure I got something from Redwoods.

title: Slayer Pink
description: Slayer, but it looks like a Trapper Keeper from the 80s.

title: Salsa Slayer
description: Salsa, but in the style of Slayer's iconic logo.

title: Sleigh What
description: I bought this specifically for a Fashion Thursday event.

title: Smokey Go Green
description: A friend bought this for me.

title: Sonic Youth Goo
description: The cover from Sonic Youth's 1990 album Goo, but in Arabic.

title: Sub Pop Gold
description: From the Sub Pop label store in Seatac airport.

title: The Swell
description: The Swell was an email newsletter from Hi-Tide Recordings, a surf label from New Jersey.

title: Three Rats
description: Three rats. For no reason at all.

title: Odin's Raven
description: Interesting design, but it faded after one wash.

title: Warrior Dash 2017
description: Souvenir from the Warrior Dash, an obstacle course race I ran in 2017.

title: Yin Yang Cats
description: I get a lot of compliments from cat lovers when I wear this shirt.

title: Alt National Park Service
description: Logo from the Alt National Park Service, a social media phenomenon from 2017.

title: Sedona Arizona Flag
description: This shirt was black when I bought it at a souvenir shop in Sedona, but it faded very quickly.

title: AV Club
description: The AV Club was a originally a culture section of The Onion newspaper, and became a vibrant digital community.

title: Bergen Norway
description: The iconic waterfront buildings of Bergen, Norway.

title: Colorado Flag
description: Colorado state flag.

title: Recuerdo de Ecuador
description: From the Mitad del Mundo park in Quito.

title: Everglades Alligator
description: Word cloud of places in Everglades National Park.

title: Millennium Falcon
description: Weird mashup of the Millennium Falcon from Star Wars, but it vaguely resembles the logo for GI Joe.

title: Stormtrooper Camouflage
description: Stormtrooper helmet, but it's covered with floral patterns. This could be a parody of a yoga brand for all I know.

title: Glacier Moose
description: Moose and sunset design from Glacier National Park. I actually bought this before I saw a moose at Glacier.

title: Go Grand
description: Grand Canyon National Park - I wish the design from the back was on the front.

title: Rebel
description: Reminiscent of the iconic Obama Hope poster by Shepard Fairey, but it's Princess Leia from Star Wars, and she's a rebel.

title: Less Than Jake
description: Shirt released along with the Less Than Jake album Silver Linings. With blue baseball-style sleeves.

title: Tribal Manta
description: Northwestern Native Anerican animal design, but it's of a manta ray. From the Crazy Shirts store in Key West.

title: Metallica Logo
description: Metallica, brought to you by the fashion buyers at Target.

title: Metric
description: Emily Haines of the Canadian indie band Metric.

title: Mighty Mighty Bosstones
description: Logo shirt from their Austin concert. You can sorta see the caulk stain that ruined it.

title: Natchez Trace
description: The Natchez Trace Parkway follows the historical Natchez trail through the state of Mississippi, and it has its own National Park store in Tupelo.

title: Norge Viking
description: This design is common in the tourist shops of Norway. My sister has the same design on a hoodie.

title: Preserve Area
description: There are not a lot of shirts with cartographic projection puns on them.

title: Reel Big Fish
description: Parody of Dr. Seuss for the ska band Reel Big Fish.

title: REI
description: Logo of the outdoor brand REI.

title: Ringo Death Starr
description: Swag from the Austin shoegaze/noise band Ringo Death Starr. The design resembles an effects pedal - which is ironic, because the guitarist uses mostly rack effects.

title: Return of the Jedi
description: Cover (and back cover) of the novelization of Return of the Jedi. Unfortunately, it has a small hole in it.

title: TACOCAT
description: Pun shirt purchased by a friend in New Mexico. We have since found that this style is sold all over the country.

title: Stay on Target
description: The targeting computer graphics from Star Wars. There are later iterations of this shirt which actually say Stay on Target, but this one has a numerical distance.

title: Tatooine Patagonia
description: Star Wars parody of the outdoors brand Patagonia. Shows the signature twin suns of Tatooine, and silhouettes of common structures from the films.

title: Thrasher Boyfriend
description: I actually had this shirt in high school, but in white. It's an obvious parody of Roy Lichtenstein's comics panels. Occasionally, some dope will ask my if this means I have a boyfriend. Am I the girl in the drawing?

title: Tree Hugger
description: Yes, I hug trees. Graphical design from outdoors brand Prana.

title: Tusken Raiders
description: Star Wars parody of former NFL team the Oakland Raiders. Raiders are a derisive name for the Tusken people of Tatooine.

title: Victoria, BC
description: Victoria, British Columbia doesn't actually touch the western coast of Canada, but I'll let it slide.
